description: Implement the highest-priority (P0/P1) security and reliability fixes identified in the audit, focusing on issues that represent actual vulnerabilities or production risks.
steps: Fix 1 - Separate JWT signing keys: In apps/backend/app/config.py, add ADMIN_JWT_SECRET (Optional[str] = None, fallback to JWT_SECRET) and RESET_TOKEN_SECRET (Optional[str] = None, fallback to JWT_SECRET). Update apps/backend/app/api/v1/admin.py to use settings.ADMIN_JWT_SECRET or settings.JWT_SECRET for admin token creation/verification. Update reset token creation in auth.py to use settings.RESET_TOKEN_SECRET or settings.JWT_SECRET. This prevents cross-token-type attacks if one secret is compromised.

Fix 2 - Auth rate limit fail-open: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/auth.py, the _check_rate_limit function has 'except Exception: pass' which means rate limiting is silently skipped when Redis is down. Change to raise HTTPException(503) instead, matching the pattern used in get_current_user() which already fails closed on Redis unavailability. Add a comment explaining the fail-closed design choice.

Fix 3 - Add bandit to CI: In .github/workflows/ci-backend.yml, add a step after the ruff linter step that runs 'bandit -c .bandit -r apps/backend/app/ -ll' (only report medium+ severity). The .bandit config already exists in the repo root.

Fix 4 - Fix deprecated datetime.utcnow usage: In apps/backend/app/models/user.py, replace 'default_factory=datetime.utcnow' with 'default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc)' for the last_reset_date and created_at and updated_at fields. Add 'from datetime import timezone' import if not present.

Fix 5 - Add test coverage reporting to CI: In .github/workflows/ci-backend.yml, change the pytest command to 'pytest apps/backend/ --tb=short -q --cov=apps/backend/app --cov-report=term-missing --cov-fail-under=40'. In .github/workflows/deploy-all.yml, make the same change to the test step.
Fix 6 - Fix TypeScript version in frontend package.json: In apps/frontend/package.json, change typescript from '~6.0.3' to '~5.8.3' (latest stable). TypeScript 6.x does not exist.

Fix 7 - Remove test dependencies from production requirements.in: In apps/backend/requirements.in, remove pytest, pytest-asyncio, and pytest-cov lines (these are test deps not needed at runtime). Add a comment at the top saying test deps should be in a separate requirements-dev.in.
acceptance_criteria: config.py has ADMIN_JWT_SECRET and RESET_TOKEN_SECRET optional fields
admin.py uses ADMIN_JWT_SECRET for admin token operations
auth.py _check_rate_limit raises 503 instead of silently passing on Redis failure
User model uses timezone-aware datetime factories
ci-backend.yml and deploy-all.yml use --cov flags in pytest
verification: Run: cd apps/backend && python -c "from app.config import Settings; print('config OK')"
Run: cd apps/backend && python -c "from app.models.user import User; print('model OK')"
findings: All 7 fixes implemented successfully. Rate limit fail-closed change required adding a _check_rate_limit mock in tests/conftest.py since tests run without Redis. 11 pre-existing test failures remain (beanie not initialized, chat TypeError, translator admin endpoints, webhook signature validation) - all verified to exist on base state before changes.
